test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which among the following is an agricultural festival of Arunachal Pradesh and celebrated by the Galo tribe?
solution:
The correct answer is __Mopin__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mopin a festival of the Galo tribe of Arunachal Pradesh is celebrated in April every year__.**

 __
 
• The Mopin festival is an important festival of Galong tribe of Arunachal Pradesh which is celebrated in the month of Lumi (April) every year.
 
• Mopin is thought to bring wealth and prosperity to households and to the Gallon community as a whole. It is also believed that the festival drives away evil shadows and spreads God’s blessing of universal happiness.
